package tag

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ListTags lists tags with pagination.
type ListTags struct {
	Tags repository.TagRepository
}

// Handle returns tags list.
func (uc ListTags) Handle(ctx context.Context, filter filters.TagFilters) ([]domain.Tag, int, error) {
	return uc.Tags.List(ctx, filter)
}
